339-677-1753-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2178-2380-6798.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-6798.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

654-5900-7898.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts.
654-5900-7898.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Smaug.
When Smaug enters, its first ability triggers, creating a number of tapped Treasure tokens
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4460-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2836-3832-4289.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2836-3832-4289.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac.

4153-6575-7175--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4153-6575-7175--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

104-1939-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1939-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3678-5411-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-5411-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

3197-4017-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4017-4716.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1825-3756-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Izzet Boilerworks and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1825-3756-6760.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Izzet Boilerworks and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

659-3499-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-3499-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

474-803-4050-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {1}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

4419-4659-5003-6554.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
4419-4659-5003-6554.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

4067-4306-6072-6281.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Graveshifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Graveshifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Graveshifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

2018-2034-6288.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding {C}{C}.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding {C}{C}.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.

575-4221-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-4221-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 creature due to Living Plane.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the creature's power.
Repeat.

1467-1987-2427-2757-3634.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Island.
You have not copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias' ability this turn.
1467-1987-2427-2757-3634.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Venser, untapping the Island.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Jin-Gitaxias, untapping the Island.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting any two applicable targets.
Jin-Gitaxias' first ability triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Venser and Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Jin-Gitaxias and Venser.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the original Ghostly Flicker to your hand from the stack.
Repeat.
